scope: For REQ-0008 (the WA cradle-to-grave lives): s 3(1) (Australian resident, eligible person, eligible overseas representative, public hospital service, public patient, recognised hospital), ss 6, 6A, 7 (orders, regulations and reciprocal agreements, their effect as inputs), s 9, s 10(1)-(5) (entitlement; 75%, 85%, 100% of the Schedule fee; the $50.00 greatest permissible gap; rounding up to 5 cents), s 14(1), s 17(1)(a), s 19(1)-(6), s 20(1), s 20A(1) (bulk billing), s 128C (no charging a public patient; 50 penalty units). The Medicare Benefits Schedule fees, the 100% prescription and the regulations relied on by ss 6A, 20A and 128C are inputs. Safety nets, simplified billing and the compensation-recovery rules (not in this Act) are not encoded.
